results.title: Gilbert fans 8 in 4 no-hit innings, Mariners strike out 12 overall in 7-3 win over the Angels
results.description: Logan Gilbert struck out eight in four no-hit innings and five Seattle pitchers combined for 12 strikeouts as the Mariners beat the Los Angeles Angels 7-3 in the regular-season finale for both teams....

Alex Bregman stars for Cubs in neutral-site win over Red Sox
results.description: Alex Bregman went 4-for-4 with two home runs and four RBIs against his former team to help the Chicago Cubs wrap up the regular season by defeating the Boston Red Sox 6-2 Sunday in St. Petersburg, Fla.

results.title: Chargers fall to 0-3 after offense wastes five takeaways in loss to Bills
results.description: Justin Herbert and the Chargers offense fail to fully capitalize on five forced turnovers by the defense in a demoralizing 24-16 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
